item.title: Deletions 70: If the fact will not fit the theory – let the theory go.: Re: Deletions 70: If the fact will not fit the theory – let the theory go.
item.content:encoded: SCP-5244 can weight between 502g and 390g. The height of a male Crab-Head is 6 centimeters tall and the Width is between 10 centimeters and 20 centimeters. The legs of the SCP-5244 are really strong and long, to kill their victims they jump on the victim's head and break any type of hat or helmet, after breaking the victim's hat the Crab opens the head of the victim and then injects small eggs into the victim's head, after the victim is dead the Crab will run around really fast ( 3,6 kilometres per hour. ), summarily deleted at -7 for plagiarizing the headcrabs from Half Life. ProcyonLotor witnessing.

item.title: 9th Annual Holiday Art Exchange~!: Re: 9th Annual Holiday Art Exchange~!
item.content:encoded:
I got this art of my Tale 'Dr. Wondertainment Goes Out With A Bang'' and it is awesome! I love the whole thing, it fits really nicely with what I imagined when I wrote this story but with some really nice added details like the Seussian architecture. I noticed the Scarlet King got a sword, I imagined him having one just like that but didn't end up adding it to the Tale. I absolutely love his uniform, old fashioned military gear like that almost perfectly matches the images I was looking at for inspiration. I love the background and the monsters which just appear as disturbing bits of arms and tendrils. And by the way, the amount of fire is completely perfect. To whoever made this, thank you and please have a Wonderful New Year!

https://m.imgur.com/a/vYFVEfW

item.title: Deletions 70: If the fact will not fit the theory – let the theory go.: Re: Deletions 70: If the fact will not fit the theory – let the theory go.
item.content:encoded:
/scp-5673 (A Wish Granting Pen) by GhostGHPM deleted at -15 and three votes.

SCP-5673 is an indestructible black pen with no visible brand name given on the object. SCP-5673 has the strange ability to grant any wish written on any type of paper as long as the wish is not malicious or will cause harm to a living being the wish will be granted.

SCP-5156 is a humanoid scp which has power of getting ignored especially for scp's. This effect doesn't seem to work on humans. The SCP foundation get to know it's power on a cleaning session of SCP-173's containment

Deleted at -20 and three votes. Supplementary pages Experiment Log 1 and Experiment Log 2 deleted following deletion of the parent page.

SCP-4273 is a black Mack Titan semi-truck, weighing approximately 125 tonnes. SCP-4273 has been observed accelerating towards 240 km/h within 2 seconds, despite not facilitating the engine power necessary to achieve said speeds[3 This has also allowed SCP-4273X to be extremely resistant to physical damage, as several tests and incidents have shown SCP-4273 being left as rusted and crumpled, yet completely immune to further harm of the SCP. See Addendum:Event-4273-4-CB for more details.

item.title: 9th Annual Holiday Art Exchange~!: Re: 9th Annual Holiday Art Exchange~!
item.content:encoded:
So, uh… my original request was admittedly ambitious, which is part of why I offered an easier option. Additionally, even if the gifter went with the original request… I expected at most a tale with the concept in the background.

However, what I actually got is so ambitious, so beyond what I could have ever asked for that it not only made me cackle with glee, it made me actually cry from sheer gratitude.

I… I seriously cannot thank you enough. What you've provided is such an extraordinarily compelling setup that I hope it inspires other authors to write their own works in this canon.

Again, thank you with every fiber of my being. <3

item.content:encoded: I received this wonderful little entry complete with bookend images! It's very WL, just what I asked for - as the title implies, it's all about Wonder, what inspires it, what shapes it, what defines it. I love it, and I'll be glad to see this posted to the Library when I figure out who wrote it and thank the everloving shit out of them!
